verdict.rationale: GoDaddy publishes a live llms.txt (probe returned HTTP 200) that indexes agent-relevant docs such as the quickstart, PAT generation, end-to-end workflow, and a machine-readable Domains v3 OpenAPI spec. It also offers an llms-full.txt and raw .md versions of its doc pages, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these llms.txt/markdown docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
